---
title: "Linear warm-up: benchmarks"
---

The links in the table below take you to posterior-wise in-depth visualizations of some key quantities and relations.

```{julia}
include("common.jl") 
 
e1 = Experiment(exp.(randn(Xoshiro(1), 6)); cache_type=:parallel)  
e2 = Experiment(randn_spd(Xoshiro(1), 6); cache_type=:parallel)  
e3 = Experiment(randn_spd(Xoshiro(1), 32); cache_type=:parallel)   
e4 = Experiment(randn_spd(Xoshiro(1), 64); cache_type=:parallel)   

pdb_es = sort(Experiment.(filter(
    # contains(r"radon"), 
    !contains(r"covid19|uk_drivers"), 
    PosteriorDB.posterior_names(pdb)); cache_type=:parallel
); by=e->e.dim)
te = Experiment("lsat_data-lsat_model"; cache_type=:parallel)
filter!(pdb_es) do e 
    e.dim < te.dim
end

QuartoComponents.Tabset((;
    overview=DataFrame([
        e.df_row for e in vcat(e1, e2, e3, e4, pdb_es)
    ])       
))
``` 
